footer.tagline: Stay up to date with your favorite podcasts.

landing.subtitle: Get daily personalized newsletters for your favorite podcasts
landing.feature1Description: Subscribe to your favorite podcasts via RSS feed
landing.feature2Description: Automatically generated summaries of new episodes
landing.feature3Description: Receive all summaries at your preferred time

auth.loginDescription: Sign in to manage your podcast newsletters
auth.errorEmailNotConfirmed: Please confirm your email address first
auth.registerDescription: Join the waitlist and be among the first to access Castletter
auth.waitlistDescription: We'll get in touch once you've been approved
auth.waitlistMessage: We've received your request. Once we activate your beta access, you'll receive an email with your invitation link.
auth.waitlistShareNote: In the meantime, we'd love it if you spread the word about Castletter.

auth.verifySuccessDescription: Your account has been successfully activated

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.settingsDescription: Configure newsletter email and delivery time
dashboard.subscriptionsDescription: Add and manage podcasts, YouTube channels and websites
dashboard.archiveDescription: View and read all sent newsletters
dashboard.welcomeCardDescription: Get daily personalized newsletters for your favorite podcasts
dashboard.nextStep3: Receive daily newsletters with podcast summaries

settings.title: Settings
settings.cardDescription: Choose where and when your newsletters are sent
settings.emailHint: Your newsletters will be sent to this address
settings.deliveryModePerPodcastHint: Choose which sources arrive immediately instead of in the daily newsletter under
settings.infoBullet1: • The daily newsletter arrives at your chosen time; sources set to “Immediately” arrive as separate emails
settings.infoBullet2: • You can use a different email address than your login email
settings.infoBullet3: • The delivery time is automatically converted to your local timezone
settings.infoBullet4: • Changes take effect with the next newsletter
settings.errorInvalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address

subscriptions.title: Sources
subscriptions.description: Manage your podcasts, YouTube channels and websites as sources for your newsletters
subscriptions.addSourceDescription: Choose the kind of source – we then only ask for the details it needs.
subscriptions.sourceTypePodcastHint: New episodes via the podcast's RSS feed URL
subscriptions.sourceTypeYoutubeHint: New videos of a public channel; Shorts are skipped
subscriptions.sourceTypeWebsiteHint: New articles of a website via its public RSS or Atom feed
subscriptions.podcastInputDescription: Paste the RSS feed URL of your favorite podcast.
subscriptions.youtubeInputDescription: New videos of the channel are transcribed and summarized just like podcast episodes.
subscriptions.websiteInputDescription: Paste the RSS or Atom feed URL – or the website address if it advertises its feed. Only complete, publicly accessible text is summarized.
subscriptions.websiteContentModeExcerpt: Excerpts – the full article is loaded from the website if it is publicly accessible
subscriptions.websiteContentModeEmpty: No articles in the feed yet
subscriptions.noSources: You haven't added any sources yet
subscriptions.sourceListHint: Choose per source whether new items arrive immediately as a separate email or bundled in the daily newsletter. Disabled sources are no longer checked; items imported before are kept.
subscriptions.emptyStateTitle: You haven't added any sources yet
subscriptions.emptyStateHint: Add your first source above – a podcast via its RSS feed, a YouTube channel or a website via RSS.
subscriptions.youtubeErrorVideoUnavailable: Video not available (private, removed or members-only)
subscriptions.youtubeErrorBlocked: YouTube blocked the request – try again later
subscriptions.youtubeErrorFetchFailed: Video data could not be loaded
subscriptions.youtubeErrorToolMissing: yt-dlp is missing in the worker – check the installation
subscriptions.youtubeErrorAudioDownload: No captions and the audio download failed
subscriptions.youtubeErrorStt: No captions and the audio transcription failed
subscriptions.websiteErrorPaywalled: Behind a paywall – no complete public text, so no summary
subscriptions.websiteErrorAccessRestricted: Only accessible with login or subscription – not summarized
subscriptions.websiteErrorContentIncomplete: Only an excerpt is available, no complete public text – not summarized
subscriptions.websiteErrorArticleUnavailable: Article no longer available (removed or invalid address)
subscriptions.websiteErrorArticleFetchFailed: Article could not be loaded – will be retried
subscriptions.deleteDescriptionPodcast: Do you really want to remove “{title}”? You will no longer receive newsletter summaries for this podcast.
subscriptions.deleteDescriptionYoutube: Do you really want to remove “{title}”? New videos of this channel will no longer be summarized.
subscriptions.deleteDescriptionWebsite: Do you really want to remove «{title}»? New articles from this website will no longer be summarized.
subscriptions.successDeliveryDaily: “{title}” will now arrive in the daily newsletter
subscriptions.youtubeErrorResolve: The channel could not be resolved
subscriptions.youtubeErrorAlreadyAdded: This channel has already been added
subscriptions.websiteErrorAlreadyAdded: This website has already been added

subscriptions.websiteErrorIsPodcast: This is a podcast feed with audio files. Add it as a podcast.
subscriptions.websiteErrorIsYoutube: This is a YouTube address. Add the channel as a YouTube channel.
